fact: On 12 January 2026 minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni presented the Maroc IA 2030 roadmap at the AI Made in Morocco day, and ministries and public bodies officially created the Institut Jazari Root, a public interest grouping, to coordinate the national network of AI centres; a dedicated AI fund was announced as planned.
title: Maroc IA 2030 : le gouvernement dévoile sa feuille de route et affiche ses ambitions
